profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at M&T Bank
profile.summary: Experienced Information Technology Service Desk with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in, Powershell, SQL, Programming, Microsoft Word, Sales, Management, Service Desk, and HTML. Strong information technology professional with a Associate’s Degree focused in Computer Science from Erie Community College.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - Cyber security - Identity Access Management (IAM)
Seinor Software Engineer - End User Computing
Software Deployment Engineer
positions.locationName: Healthnow New York  257 W Genesee St, Buffalo, NY 14202
positions.description:
•Created 60 automations using PowerShell, Windows Batch, SQL, XML and XAML to reduce call times for a team of 20 IT Service Desk LVL 1 and LVL 2 technicians’
•Integrate LDAP into Kace Asset management to tie user accounts to devices to expand into LDAP Asset Management for over 4000 Desktop endpoints across 2400 Users
•Developed .Net PowerShell to integrate data from LDAP, SharePoint, VMware, Quest Kace, Active Directory and Microsoft Intune and consolidated into CSV for readable reports for ITIL Management
•Work with Lead Developer on eDiscovery project to keyword match e-mail Data, break down unstructured content into data structures to be queried for relevant query terms per audit guidelines using C#
•Introduce the Windows SDK to Win 32 development teams to-remediate legacy applications to work with Windows 10 Modern Management
•Work with Enterprise Architecture to implement application rationalization and standardization governance to eliminate un-needed software to utilize applications already in environment
•Configure and manage Device Management Systems such as Quest Kace and Microsoft Intune
•Led migration from on-premises to hybrid Cloud environments of Microsoft Azure and Amazon AWS and corporate endpoint management 
•Automated Windows 7 to Window 10 machine migration utilizing Ansible Tower playbooks, Microsoft Graph API and PowerShell to replace a 15-step manual workflow spanning multiple support teams
•Established the silent installation and patching of Cognizant TriZetto Facets to 3000 endpoints with silent deployment and registration of 8 ActiveX/COM Facets extensions
•Implemented Microsoft Intune For Windows 10 with over 4000 managed endpoints and 350 Applications delivered through the Microsoft Company Portal
•Optimized the Microsoft Imaging from 2 hours to 30 minutes to expedite Endpoint deployment and Mobile Device Management Enrollment by implementing modern Scripting and replacing legacy WIM deployment and replacing Windows batch with PowerShell
positions.insights: Complex Systems, Coding Standards and +30 skills

positions.title: IT Deskside Technician at HealthNow NY
positions.locationName: Healthnow New York  257 W Genesee St, Buffalo, NY 14202
positions.description:
Create automation for silent software installs and new fixes.
 Insure software installs current in the Quest Kace appliance.
 Work with developers and Application Admins to deploy updated or new software.
 Maintain Image used for imaging new pc builds.
 Assist Executives with immediate personalized support.
 Resolve escalated tickets from level 1 Service Desk Technician.
 Complete hardware replacements of malfunction hardware.
positions.insights: Problem Analysis, Version Control and +16 skills

positions.title: IT Service Desk Technician LVL1
positions.locationName: Healthnow New York  257 W Genesee St, Buffalo, NY 14202
positions.description:
Handle incoming requests from end users via telephone, e-mail, and chat.

Attempt to  customer calls in the first call; ensure follow up and\​or escalate when necessary.

Record, track, and document Service Desk request problem-solving process, including all 
successful and unsuccessful actions taken, through to final resolution or escalation.
Apply diagnostic utilities to aid in troubleshooting.

Test fixes to ensure problem has been adequately resolved.

Assist users with mobile device trouble shooting and\​or escalate when necessary.
positions.insights: Problem Analysis, Lateral Thinking and +5 skills

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
 Assist clients with understanding their needs and assisting the clients vehicle selection to fit their needs

 Explain benefits of organization and product

 Stay current with new features and options available with products

 Responsible for maintaining the organization of lot and showroom

 Aid in Financing process between client and various Financial Institutions

 Gather information from client to insure proper documents required for vehicle purchase 

 Explain and assist with signing of legally binding contracts between the organization, State DMV, and Financial Institution and client

 Demonstrate technology and features of the vehicle client has purchased so the client has an 
understanding of how to use the features in their new vehicle

positions.title: Resale Centre Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
 Assist sales professionals with coordinating delivery of pre-owned inventory

 Determine one of four reconditioning processes for new inventory

 Supervise Lot personnel to insure productivity and maintenance of lot and inventory. 

 Provide sales personnel with detailed information on pre-owned inventory

 Maintain log of inventory to keep track of reconditioning process, overall inventory, and to provide current information to sales personnel

 Communicate with dealer and manufacturer

 Mediate between Used Car Director and Service, Detail, Collision Center, and Vendor sublets
through the recondition process

 Relay directions to coordinate the process for inventory that is to be wholesaled

 Delegate or perform miscellaneous tasks required by Used Car Director

 Partake in interview process with manager, if manger was unavailable, cast my own interview and pass along my judgment to manager to determine a final interview

 Responsibility added to my position as the demand of business grew

 Study terminated lease vehicles to determine if worthy for inventory and then purchase for inventory if deemed so

positions.title: Shuttle Dispatch
positions.description:
Organize transportation schedule between nine shuttle vans and seven locations within in a thirty mile radius 

Shuttled customers while dispatching if necessary. 

Log gas vouchers of shuttle vehicles in spreadsheet for accounting to review at month end. 

Supervise drivers in managers absence

Communicate between the service departments at each location and centralized call center to 
optimize efficiency and customer experience

positions.title: Cook
positions.description:
Answer incoming calls to assist customers with placing their food order

Cash customers out and bring them their food orders

Prepare orders in timely fashion for the customer

Deliver orders to customers to their requested address

Clean restaurant to keep in code with the State Health Department
